service_boundary: Represents the Z.ai Model API operated through api.z.ai, not the Z.ai chat product, open-weight GLM releases, or GLM models hosted elsewhere.
regional_controls: The reviewed Model API documentation uses a common platform endpoint and does not establish customer-selected inference regions.
retention_controls: The API-specific terms govern submitted inputs and outputs; the reviewed public technical docs do not establish a universal customer-configurable retention tier.
routing: Customers select Z.ai model endpoints; OpenAI SDK compatibility is an interface choice, not cross-provider routing.
customization: The reviewed public Model API focuses on hosted models and does not establish customer-supplied weight deployment.
strengths: Direct access to the GLM family across several modalities.
Official examples document both native HTTP and OpenAI SDK access.
tradeoffs: Public regional and retention controls require further contract-level review.
The direct service is limited to Z.ai-operated model families.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Z.ai API reference, for the Z.ai Model API

upstream_disclosure.note: The privacy policy states the operator processes the content: "This information is processed in real-time to provide you with the Service." No subprocessor is named.
upstream_disclosure.scope: Z.ai privacy policy, for the Z.ai Model API

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: "Create an API Key in the [API Keys] management page." and every documented request uses that key.
credential_handling.scope: Z.ai HTTP guide, for the Z.ai Model API

cache_isolation.note: The cache guide documents the caching feature and its billing but never states whether a cache is scoped to the account that created it.
cache_isolation.scope: Z.ai cache guide, for the Z.ai Model API

vulnerability_disclosure.note: The terms of use publish a disclosure route without a named contact: "If you discover any vulnerabilities or defects in the services provided by Z.ai, you are encouraged to report them through the feedback feature available within the interface or through the designated contact methods". No security.txt is served.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Z.ai terms of use, for the Z.ai Model API

independent_audit.note: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent attestation is named in the API reference, the terms, or the privacy policy.
independent_audit.scope: Z.ai API reference, for the Z.ai Model API
